_comments.drop-chance: Chance (0.0 - 1.0) to drop the spawner when mined with silk touch
_comments.drop-as-item: If true, the spawner drops on the ground. If false, it goes into the player's inventory
_comments.durability-damage: Extra durability taken from the pickaxe when mining a spawner. 0 means none
_comments.player-damage-percent: Percent of the player's max health to deal as magic damage. 50 = half. 0 means none
_comments.explosions: Roll 0 to 1, then check massive, large, then small. Defaults: 10% massive, 30% large, 30% small, 30% none
_comments.require-adjacent: If true, spawners can only be placed against another spawner
_comments.require-same-mob: If true, the placed spawner must match the mob type of the spawner it is placed against
_comments.max-cluster: Max number of spawners in one connected group. -1 means no limit
